title: Add prefetch census sampler and invocation scrub playbook
author: Marta Alvarez
release_notes: Adds a lightweight prefetch census sampler to improve cache warmup telemetry and a runbook (invocation scrub playbook) for operators to triage prefetched invocation anomalies. No customer-visible API changes.
description: Context: We see a recurring class of SLO regressions driven by inefficient prefetch behavior: infrequent high-cost prefetched invocations that inflate token cost and create noisy alerting during trading-hour spikes. This PR introduces two coordinated deliverables: 1) a prefetch census sampler (runtime sampling component) that records compact, pseudonymized census buckets for prefetched invocations to make long-tail prefetched cost observable at low cardinality; and 2) an operator-oriented "invocation scrub" playbook and dashboard that surfaces prefetched cohorts, entropy signals, and suggested alert dampening. Motivation: enable low-overhead, privacy-preserving visibility into prefetch efficacy and failure modes so SRE and runtime teams can tune prefetch parameters without turning on high-cardinality traces or full payload capture. Summary of changes: - runtime/sampler/prefetch_census.py: new lightweight sampler with reservoir-like buckets, entropy-weighted selection, and K-anon pseudonymization for prompt fingerprints. Emits metrics: prefetch.census.bucket_count, prefetch.census.bucket_latency_p50/p95, prefetch.census.cost_estimate_sum and prefetch.census.sample_rate. - runtime/telemetry/emitters.go: added compact protobuf schema and emitter helper to send census rollups to observability pipeline. - observability/dashboards/prefetch_census_dash.json: operator dashboard with: census sparkline, cohort cost heatmap, prefetch hit/miss ratio, and suggested alert score. - observability/runbooks/invocation_scrub.md: playbook with triage steps, recommended alert thresholds, and rollback instructions. - metrics/alerts/prefetch_alerts.yaml: tuned alert rules (quiet-window gating + cohort-based suppressor) and annotation links to playbook. - tests/sampler/test_census_sampler.py: unit and microbench tests validating reservoir behavior and pseudonymization. - e2e/replay/prefetch_replay_workflow.yaml: replay harness for backfilling census across a tenant window. Commits (summary): ["7b2c9d3: initial sampler implementation and unit tests", "a4f8e11: add protobuf emitter and telemetry integration", "c9d2fac: dashboard + runbook + alert rules", "d0aa3b2: fix sampling edge-case (zero-prefetch) and add additional tests", "e44f1f5: CI & lint fixes; update docs"]. Files changed (high level): ["runtime/sampler/prefetch_census.py", "runtime/telemetry/emitters.go", "observability/dashboards/prefetch_census_dash.json", "observability/runbooks/invocation_scrub.md", "metrics/alerts/prefetch_alerts.yaml", "tests/sampler/test_census_sampler.py", "e2e/replay/prefetch_replay_workflow.yaml", "docs/notes/prefetch-census.md"]. Testing and validation: - Unit tests: added coverage for reservoir boundary conditions and pseudonymization; all unit tests pass locally. - Integration: local-dev emitter forwards compact rollups to staging observability pipeline; dashboards render expected sparklines for synthesized replay data. - Replay: used e2e/replay harness to replay a 24h tenant window with prefetched invocations to validate heatmap shapes and alert clustering. Performance impact: sampler is micro-optimized and runs inline in the prefetch path with a configurable sample_rate (default 1/1000). Benchmarks on an r5-like instance show <0.15ms p99 added latency per prefetch call at default settings. Config & rollout: guarded by feature flag runtime.feature_flags.prefetch_census_v1 and a gating config in runtime/config/prefetch.yaml. Rollout plan: enable in staging for 48h -> 10% of traffic in main -> 100% after 7 days and signal stability. Rollback: flip feature flag off (no schema changes); emitter buffers can be drained and pipeline ignores unknown bucket ids. Security & privacy: pseudonymization is one-way hash with salt stored in KMS; no raw prompt text included in rollups. Compliance signoff: security reviewed (Jonah Kim) for data minimization. CI: unit/integration/lint passed in CI; e2e replay was run manually and results attached. Related work: follows ENG-3012 (prefetch observability spike investigation) and complements ENG-3099 (cohort-based alerting). Ask reviewers: please focus review on reservoir algorithm correctness, protobuf schema compatibility, and the alert gating logic. After merge: operator rotation: mark runbook with oncall owners and schedule a 30m knowledge share.
